import 'package:xberg/xberg.dart';

    final config = await createExtractionConfigFromJson(json: '{"url":{"mode":"document"}}');
    final result = await XbergBridge.extractBatch(inputs, config: config);
    stdout.writeln(result.results);
    stdout.writeln(result.results[0].content);
    stdout.writeln(result.results[1].content);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
